name: group1_minus_nU
description: Group (1), static part with constant factor: Ric(K,K) = U(1 - s^2) + V0 s^2 + J s with U = x^3 nU/(32(1-x)w), V0 = x^3 nV/(64(1-x)w^2), J^2 = z x^8 S L^2/(1024(1-x)^2 w). From -nU >= 0, -nV >= 0, P3 = nV^2 - 4 z x^2 S L^2 w^3 >= 0 (V0^2 >= J^2) and P6 = 4 nU^2 - z x^2 S L^2 w >= 0 (J^2 <= 4U^2) it follows that max_s N(s) <= 0, hence Ric <= 0 (the non-strict inequality suffices in 2+1). This certificate: mnU >= 0.
